scope: T04 services draft and shared button proposal
prompt:
Edit the reference screenshot into ONE high fidelity design presentation sheet containing TWO complete desktop app pages side by side, each represented as a 1280 by 1000 CSS-pixel viewport, overall wide image about 2560 by 1000. No browser address bar, no device frames, no floating perspective. Reference image role: incumbent Randevu app identity, top wordmark header, narrow navy group rail and adjacent light contextual navigation drawer, pale background, typography, flat surfaces and existing colors. Preserve this identity while proposing a calmer services task area and noticeably more minimalist buttons. The reference has synthetic content; replace the content as specified. No email or personal contact in header, only İşletme sahibi and Çıkış yap.

LEFT PAGE is the list route /yonetim/hizmetler. One page heading Hizmetler and short line Hizmetlerin adını, süresini ve fiyatını yönetin. Content is a flat list/table with fine horizontal dividers and column labels Hizmet, Süre, Fiyat, Durum. No enclosing heavy card, repeated heading, chart, counts, illustrations or statistics. A modest filled BLUE Yeni hizmet button sits at the right of the heading row. Four clearly fictional sample rows: Saç kesimi | 30 dk | 350,00 TL | Aktif; Sakal düzenleme | 20 dk | 200,00 TL | Aktif; Saç ve sakal | 50 dk | 500,00 TL | Aktif; Bakım uygulaması | 40 dk | 450,00 TL | Pasif. Each row has only ONE compact filled navy Düzenle button. No row delete or status buttons: these are available on the separate editor. Footer modest filled navy Listeyi yenile, Önceki, plain Sayfa 1, Sonraki, with Previous disabled. No made-up search/filter supported by no API.

RIGHT PAGE is a SEPARATE page at /yonetim/hizmetler/example/duzenle. Same header and navigation chrome. Compact filled pale-solid Listeye dön at top, then page heading Saç kesimi and textual status Aktif. A simple, readable left-aligned service form with labels Hizmet adı, Süre (dakika), Fiyat (TL), values Saç kesimi, 30, 350,00. Name field full form width; duration and price share two columns. Form maximum about 560 px, plenty of calm blank space, no list below. Compact filled blue Kaydet and compact filled navy Vazgeç on one row, then smaller filled navy Güncel kaydı yükle below with adequate 16px vertical separation. After a generous divider a separate Durum ve silme section: description Pasifleştirme kaydı korur. Silme listeden kaldırır; değişiklik geçmişi korunur. Two compact buttons Pasifleştir in navy and Sil in muted red. These initiate confirmation, they do not perform immediate deletion. Do not show a fake success message or an open confirmation mixed into the normal form.

BUTTON DESIGN IMPORTANT: Visually compact minimalist rectangles, 44px accessible clickable height, about 14px medium-weight system sans type, 12px horizontal padding, modest 6px corners, flat opaque color with no shadow, no transparency and no decorative icons. Width follows the text, never a fixed long width or oversized full-width block. Primary blue #4C72AD with white text, secondary navy #405775 with white text, pale-filled navigation #EDF1F7 with dark navy text, destructive #A44D45 with white text only in destructive area. Smaller visual mass than reference, all still readable. Preserve at least 44x44 touch targets and 16px between stacked action rows. Main group rail may use compact 72px tall icon-and-label controls so multi-line labels remain readable. Rest of common navigation structure stays identical: İşletme, Ekip, Hesap, Değişiklik kayıtları, drawer heading İşletme with İşletme bilgileri, İşletme saatleri, Hizmetler selected, Menüyü kapat.

Established palette ONLY: canvas #FAFBFD, white fields, ink #253044, blue #4C72AD, navy #405775, muted red #A44D45, fine pale borders. System sans text and data, Unna-like serif only Randevu wordmark. Body text around16px. No marketing photography, no logo, no gradients, no thick borders, no shadows, no pills, no fake modules, no dark theme. Tiny unobtrusive text below each page may identify Liste and Düzenleme; all visible UI text must be Turkish with correct accents. Clearly render the two separate page states rather than a split editor sharing the list. These are static design proposals with synthetic example data, not live API success.
